caption: What my 19-month-old ate today 🤍 A full day of simple, balanced meals that support growth — without overcomplicating feeding. Breakfast: Blueberry cottage cheese oats + peanut butter + mandarine Lunch: Egg feta pasta + avocado + orange Snack: Applesauce muffin + broccoli + Greek yogurt Dinner: Mushroom lamb + veggie rice + strawberries + Greek yogurt — Feeding toddlers every day can feel overwhelming… constantly thinking what to make and if it’s balanced. That’s why I created MunchMind 🤍 It plans everything for you — meals, recipes, grocery list… done. 👉 Find it in my bio #toddlermealideas #whatmybabyeats #babyledweaning #startingsolids #babymeals
